detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Frozen Ship is a narrative adventure set in the harsh conditions of a post-apocalyptic world, combining open-world survival with managing an entire mobile city.

Explore the frozen Earth on your own, command your crew and your ship, make tough decisions — and try to survive where humanity has almost vanished. 

You will undertake a journey through cold, hunger, dangers, political intrigues, and conflicting settlements in a world that no longer forgives mistakes.

You are the captain of the ship. 

After a global catastrophe that forever changed the planet's climate, you lead an expedition aboard a massive ship capable of crossing the endless snowy wastelands. There is a crew of 20 people, several buildings, supplies, and hope to find a new place to live. Every decision you make affects the fate of your crew and the outcome of the entire mission.

The Living and Dangerous World 

Beyond the ship, you'll find a procedurally generated open world filled with dangers and stories:

  • Predators and deadly enemies

  • Hunting, searching for, and gathering resources

  • Firearms, diplomatic, and armed conflicts

  • Abandoned hospitals, shops, homes, railways, and entire cities 

The world changes from game to game, creating new situations, routes, and challenges.

Settlements, Factions, and Conflicts 

On your journey, you will encounter survivor settlements — small towns, each with their own rules, problems, and visions for the future. 

  • Friendly and hostile settlements

  • Factions involved in prolonged conflicts and those simply trying to survive

  • Stories of survivors, lore, main and side quests

  • Will you align with a particular faction or try to maintain a balance between all of them — the choice is yours. 

Your actions can shift the balance of power, determine the fate of entire communities, and perhaps influence the future of humanity.

Ship and Crew Management

Your ship is more than just a means of transport — it is a mobile base and home for the entire expedition:

  • Transform the ship into a living city with its own infrastructure

  • Build and upgrade buildings necessary for living and survival

  • Craft items and equipment

  • Research technologies

  • Enact laws and impose necessary restrictions

  • Assign crew members to work inside the ship or gather resources 

Keep an eye on your crew’s well-being: illnesses, fatigue, fear, and faith in the expedition’s success — everything matters.

Trade and Survival

 In the world of Frozen Ship, resources mean life:

  • Make deals to ensure survival

  • Sell found items

  • Buy rare gear and supplies

  • Complete quests for traders

Sometimes, a successful deal can save the expedition, while a mistake could lead to disaster.

Every decision you make impacts the fate of your crew. 

Who to entrust the important tasks, who to send on dangerous expeditions, and how to keep the team united in the face of eternal cold — the choices are yours.
